tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background, a soft oat-white like morning light. Default ground for body text.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card and panel surfaces on cream; text on lake, beech, earth and clay buttons.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate surface: info cards, the address panel, list rows. Ink text on it (11.3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body text, including on every pale tint (11.9:1 on cream; 6.4:1 or better on every fill in this palette).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: addresses, opening hours, captions (5.2:1 on cream, 5.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: lake
tokens.usage: Brand colour, Lake Hawea seen through morning mist. Primary buttons and links. White text on it (5.5:1); as link text on cream 5:1. As text on lake-tint, 18px+ or bold only (4.3:1).

tokens.name: lake-tint
tokens.usage: Header band, hero wash, lake and ski tags, active language chip. Ink text on it (10.4:1).

tokens.name: lake-mist
tokens.usage: Mid lake blue for fills: map water, illustration, decorative bands. Fill only; ink text on it (7.1:1).

tokens.name: beech
tokens.usage: Soft forest green. Secondary buttons, the footer, hike section headings at display size. White text on it (5.9:1); as text on cream 5.4:1.

tokens.name: fern
tokens.usage: Sage green for fills: map land, illustration, dividers in outdoor sections. Fill only; ink text on it (7.3:1).

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Pale green wash: hiking tags and the Local hikes section. Ink text on it (10.2:1).

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Soft glacial teal of the Hawea and Clutha rivers: river-track and swim tags as a fill, river lines on maps. Fill only; ink text on it (6.6:1).

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Soft soil-and-timber brown. Biking and eateries section accents, a tertiary button. White text on it (5.9:1); as text on cream 5.4:1.

tokens.name: schist
tokens.usage: Warm stone of the Central Otago schist: photo frames, section dividers, illustration. Fill only; ink text on it (6.4:1).

tokens.name: oat
tokens.usage: Pale warm wash: biking and eateries tags. Ink text on it (9.7:1).

tokens.name: tussock
tokens.usage: Soft golden accent for the personal touches: animal cards, 'Dexter says hi' badges, visitor-map pins. Ink text on it (8.9:1); never a text colour.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Sparing warm call to action, e.g. 'Add your home town', when lake would blend in. White text on it (5.7:1). One per screen at most.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on cream, white and mist. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

families.display: Fraunces, "Noto Serif SC", "Noto Serif JP", "Noto Serif KR", Georgia, serif
families.sans: Figtree, "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Great little local café and country store.
styles.usage: All running text. Never smaller on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags and eyebrows above headings. Latin scripts only; CJK pages use small instead.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text, between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between heading and content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; generous breathing room is part of the alpine feel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, photos, the Wi-Fi QR panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, language chips, badges.
